caveats: Fixed small diagnostic subsets are not the full final validation population.
Only six unseen-rig scenes match the full unseen-rig validation support exactly.
GT-assisted rescaling and GT-depth replacement are diagnostic interventions, not guaranteed error bounds, not deployable metrics.
Module swaps are inference interventions and cannot replace matched training controls.
Euclidean task-gradient cosine is not the AdamW-preconditioned update direction.

release.caveat: Read-only gradients at fixed endpoint in eval mode. Euclidean gradient cosines are not causal AdamW update attribution.

final_ema.caveat: Read-only gradients at fixed endpoint in eval mode. Euclidean gradient cosines are not causal AdamW update attribution.
